qualification: Candidates must satisfy all the following requirements: || Passed Class 12 under the 10+2 education system with Physics, Chemistry and Biology as compulsory subjects. || Completed a four-year B.Sc. Nursing programme from a recognized nursing institution, or completed General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) followed by a two-year Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing programme. || Possess valid and active registration with the Madhya Pradesh Nurses Registration Council. || Important: GNM qualification alone is not listed as sufficient for this recruitment. Nursing programme. || The official rulebook states that educational qualifications will be considered as on the application commencement date, 20 November 2026. salary: Selected candidates will be appointed to contractual Staff Nurse posts under National Health Mission, Madhya Pradesh, with fixed monthly remuneration. || The appointment is contractual and subject to National Health Mission service rules and applicable conditions. age_limit: The minimum and maximum age limits are calculated as on 1 January 2026. || The notification provides a relaxation of five years in the upper age limit for eligible SC, ST, OBC, women and persons with disabilities, subject to the applicable Madhya Pradesh Government rules and domicile conditions. || The official rules state that the upper age relaxation is available to eligible Madhya Pradesh residents. qualification: ITI Electrician, ITI Fitter and More – 100 Posts
salary: The stipend is paid monthly, shared between NCL (25%) and the Government of Madhya Pradesh (75%), and is paid as per the applicable MMSKY provisions and guidelines. || The contributions of NCL and the Government of Madhya Pradesh are regulated as per the scheme guidelines. After trainees join their respective Areas, their duly authenticated attendance is verified regularly by the Area and sent to the HRD Department, NCL Headquarters, for stipend payment. selection_process: Applications received against the training opportunities published by NCL will be scrutinised as per the prescribed eligibility conditions. || Eligible candidates may be called for an interview/interaction online, by telephone or by another suitable means, as per the scheme provisions. || Shortlisted candidates may be called to a designated place for document verification and further joining formalities. || Final selection will be made by NCL as per the applicable MMSKY provisions and guidelines. || Selection is subject to verification of eligibility and approval of the training contract by the competent authority on the MMSKY portal. Merely submitting an application gives no right to selection or training.
